quarters.notes: CONTROL PASSES for revS as the brief predicted: the method reports agreement here, licensing the OURS_WRONG calls on the other 3 quarters. IMPORTANT SIDE FINDING (outside the revS scope but bears on the brief's characterisation of this era as 'properly distinct'/fixed): Note 12 of this filing states verbatim 'The Company does not have investment in any subsidiaries, associates, joint ventures or controlled structure entity ... and thus requirement of the consolidated financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2025 is not applicable' -- i.e. NO consolidated statement exists for this quarter at all. Yet our stored revC=3831.5 is not null -- it equals this SAME filing's Interest income (38,315mn/10=3831.5) exactly. So the con slot has NOT been fixed at the control boundary: it still holds the wrong row (Interest income), now merely LOOKING 'properly distinct' from revS only because revS itself got corrected via a different route (very likely the standard post-listing XBRL pipeline switching on) while revC kept coming from whatever produced it in the defect window. This was not one of the four assigned cells and is not adjudicated to a verdict here, but it means 'revC diverges from revS from 2025-06-30' should NOT be read as evidence the defect ended for con -- only revS's defect ended. Flagging for a future packet.

summary.mechanism: The stored standalone-revenue slot for 2024-06-30 through 2025-03-31 (HDBFS's pre-IPO period, when only debt/NCD listings existed) holds the filing's 'Interest income' sub-line instead of 'Total revenue from operations' (Interest income + Sale of services + Other financial charges + Net gain on fair value changes + Net gain/(loss) on derecognised financial instruments). Root cause matches the AADHARHFC precedent exactly: a pre-IPO Screener-scrape route anchored only on PAT, blind to which revenue row it grabbed. The defect ends exactly at 2025-06-30, HDBFS's first quarter as an NSE/BSE-listed equity (IPO 2025-07-02), when the standard post-listing pipeline took over for revS. Because HDBFS has NO subsidiaries (confirmed explicitly in the 2025-06-30 filing's Note 12, and confirmed empirically -- the Standalone and Consolidated pages of the 2024-06-30/2024-12-31/2025-03-31 filings are digit-for-digit identical), con=std is a GENUINE identity in the defect window, not a scrape artefact -- both slots hold the same wrong number because the underlying truth (Total revenue from operations) is itself identical across bases. The revC slot's own defect persists past the control boundary (still Interest income at 2025-06-30) even though no consolidated statement exists to source it from at all -- an open item, not adjudicated here.
